title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
summary:
Google has officially begun removing Manifest V2 (MV2) extensions from the Chrome Web Store, marking a major milestone in its transition to the Manifest V3 (MV3) framework. A significant casualty of this shift is the original **uBlock Origin (UBO)**, one of the world’s most popular ad-blockers, which is now being disabled for Chrome users.

The transition is part of a multi-year plan by Google to overhaul the extension ecosystem. Google justifies the move by claiming MV3 provides better security, privacy, and performance. However, the shift has faced intense criticism from the privacy community. The primary issue lies in how MV3 handles content filtering: it replaces the powerful "blocking webRequest API" with the more restrictive "declarativeNetRequest API." This change limits the number of filtering rules an extension can apply and shifts control from the extension to the browser itself.

Because the original uBlock Origin relies on MV2 capabilities to provide comprehensive filtering, it cannot function under the new rules. While developer Raymond Hill has released **uBlock Origin Lite**, a version compatible with MV3, it lacks the advanced features and real-time customization of the original.

Users currently using MV2 extensions will see them automatically disabled, with Chrome prompting them to find alternatives. For those who wish to maintain full ad-blocking capabilities, the article suggests switching to browsers like **Firefox**, which has committed to maintaining support for the necessary MV2 APIs, or **Brave**, which utilizes built-in ad-blocking that bypasses the limitations of the Manifest framework.
chinese_title: 谷歌已从 Chrome 网上应用店下架 MV2 扩展，包括 UBO
chinese_summary:
谷歌已正式开始从 Chrome 网上应用店移除 Manifest V2 (MV2) 扩展程序，这标志着其向 Manifest V3 (MV3) 框架过渡的一个重要里程碑。此次转变的一个重大受害者是原版 **uBlock Origin (UBO)**——全球最受欢迎的广告拦截器之一，目前正被 Chrome 禁用。

这一过渡是谷歌重塑扩展生态系统的多年计划的一部分。谷歌辩称，MV3 能提供更好的安全性、隐私性和性能。然而，这一转变遭到了隐私社区的强烈批评。核心问题在于 MV3 处理内容过滤的方式：它将功能强大的“阻塞式 webRequest API”替换为限制更多的“声明式 NetRequest API”。这一变化限制了扩展程序可以应用的过滤规则数量，并将控制权从扩展程序转移到了浏览器本身。

由于原版 uBlock Origin 依赖 MV2 的功能来提供全面的过滤服务，它无法在新的规则下运行。虽然开发者 Raymond Hill 已发布了与 MV3 兼容的 **uBlock Origin Lite**，但它缺乏原版的高级功能和实时自定义选项。

目前仍在使用 MV2 扩展的用户将发现它们被自动禁用，且 Chrome 会提示用户寻找替代品。对于那些希望维持完整广告拦截功能的用户，建议切换到 **Firefox** 等浏览器（Firefox 已承诺维持对必要 MV2 API 的支持），或使用 **Brave**，后者利用内置的广告拦截功能绕过了 Manifest 框架的限制。

title: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
summary:
Although the provided title mentions bird identification, the actual content describes Jason Tucker’s experience migrating his personal media library from Apple’s cloud to private storage.

Using a tool called **ImmiBridge**, Tucker successfully transferred **51,000 photos and videos** from iCloud to his self-hosted **Immich** server. The entire migration process was completed over a single weekend. This project serves as a guide for homelab and self-hosting enthusiasts looking to gain full control over their data by moving away from proprietary cloud services and onto independent, locally managed storage solutions.

title: Playa Phone
summary:
Located at the corner of 3:30 and Ceiba in Black Rock City, the "Playa Phone" is a modified phone booth operating during the Burning Man festival. Situated in front of the Temple of the Flying Spaghetti Monster, the booth allows attendees to make free five-minute calls to almost anywhere in the world via an internet-based system.

The project also facilitates connection from the outside world. Individuals can dial **+1 (775) 557-4848** to potentially speak with a random "Burner" walking past the booth. Because it is a single-line setup, callers may frequently encounter busy signals if the phone is in use, or the line may disconnect after six rings if no one is available to answer. 

If you receive a call from this number, it is likely a friend, loved one, or a stranger from the festival reaching out. The creator replaced the booth’s original hardware to bypass traditional payment systems, utilizing VoIP technology to bridge the gap between the remote desert event and the rest of the world. Further information on the project can be found through SFGATE or the dedicated Reddit announcement thread.

chinese_summary:
“Playa Phone”位于黑石城3:30与Ceiba路的交界处，是一个在火人节期间运行的改装电话亭。该电话亭坐落于飞天面条神教寺庙前，参与者可以通过网络系统向全球绝大部分地区免费拨打五分钟电话。

该项目还方便了外界与场内的联系。拨打 **+1 (775) 557-4848**，就有机会与路过电话亭的随机一位“火人”通话。由于该设备采用单线设置，如果电话正忙，拨打者可能会经常遇到占线信号；若无人接听，电话则会在响铃六声后自动挂断。

如果您接到这个号码的来电，很可能是身在节日现场的朋友、亲人或陌生人正试图与您联系。创作者更换了电话亭的原始硬件以绕过传统支付系统，利用VoIP技术在偏远的沙漠活动与世界其他地方之间架起了桥梁。有关该项目的更多信息，可通过SFGATE或Reddit上的专题公告贴获取。

title: Smartphone LED detects hidden cameras with AI
summary:
Researchers have developed an innovative method to detect hidden cameras by leveraging a standard smartphone’s built-in sensors and Artificial Intelligence. This system, often referred to in technical circles as LAPD (Laser-Assisted Pinhole Detection), utilizes the smartphone’s Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensor or LED flash to identify illicit recording devices.

The technology works on the principle of retroreflection. When the smartphone emits light pulses, they reflect off the lenses of hidden cameras and bounce directly back to the source. Because many common objects—such as mirrors, jewelry, or metallic screws—also reflect light, the system employs a deep-learning AI model to analyze these reflections. The AI is trained to distinguish the unique optical signature of a camera lens from other background "noise."

In experimental settings, this AI-driven approach has demonstrated significantly higher accuracy than manual human inspections or existing commercial detectors. By transforming common consumer hardware into a professional-grade security tool, this advancement provides a portable and accessible way for individuals to protect their privacy in sensitive environments like hotel rooms, changing areas, and rental properties.
chinese_title: 智能手机LED利用AI检测隐藏摄像头
chinese_summary:
研究人员开发出一种创新方法，利用普通智能手机的内置传感器和人工智能来检测隐藏摄像头。该系统在技术领域通常被称为 LAPD（激光辅助针孔检测），它利用智能手机的飞行时间（ToF）传感器或 LED 闪光灯来识别非法偷拍设备。

该技术基于逆向反射原理工作。当智能手机发出光脉冲时，光线会从隐藏摄像头的镜头上反射并直接回传至光源。由于镜子、珠宝或金属螺丝等许多常见物体也会反射光线，该系统采用深度学习人工智能模型来分析这些反射。人工智能经过训练，能够从背景“噪声”中辨别出摄像头镜头独特的光学特征。

在实验环境下，这种人工智能驱动的方法表现出的准确率显著高于人工检查或现有的商用探测器。通过将普通的消费级硬件转化为专业级安全工具，这一进步为个人在酒店客房、更衣室和出租房等敏感环境中保护隐私提供了一种便携且易用的方式。

title: Terence Tao explains 6 essential mathematical concepts [video]
summary:
Based on the title provided, this video features world-renowned mathematician **Terence Tao** breaking down complex mathematical theories into accessible insights. While the "Content" provided is primarily YouTube metadata, Tao’s public lectures and educational features generally focus on several key pillars of modern mathematics.

A summary of the essential concepts typically covered by Tao includes:

1.  **The Nature of Prime Numbers:** Tao explains that primes are the "atoms" of mathematics. He discusses his work on the Green-Tao theorem, which proves that the sequence of prime numbers contains arithmetic progressions of any length.
2.  **Compressed Sensing:** This is a revolutionary concept in signal processing. Tao explains how we can reconstruct high-resolution data (such as MRI images or digital photos) from very few measurements, a technique that has transformed modern technology.
3.  **Partial Differential Equations (PDEs):** Tao describes how math is used to model the physical world, from the flow of fluids to the movement of waves, highlighting the difficulty and beauty of predicting complex systems.
4.  **Randomness and Patterns:** A major theme in Tao’s work is how random systems can surprisingly exhibit order. He explains how mathematicians use probability to solve problems that appear entirely deterministic.
5.  **The Collatz Conjecture:** Tao often uses this famous unsolved problem—which involves a simple arithmetic sequence—to illustrate that even the most basic-looking questions can require profound new levels of mathematical logic to solve.
6.  **Mathematical Heuristics:** Beyond specific formulas, Tao emphasizes the "art" of problem-solving, moving from rigorous logic to intuitive "pre-rigorous" thinking to find breakthroughs.

**Conclusion:**
Tao’s core message is that mathematics is a creative, collaborative language used to decode the universe. He encourages shifting the perception of math from rote calculation to a dynamic process of exploration and discovery.

title: Dwarf Fortress is getting the mother of all magic updates
summary:
The upcoming "Myth and Magic" update for *Dwarf Fortress*, scheduled for release later this year, aims to revolutionize the game’s sorcery through deep procedural generation. Co-founder Tarn Adams explains that the update moves beyond simple spell effects, integrating magic into the "fundamental cosmological makeup" of each generated universe.

Key features of the update include:

*   **Procedural World-Building:** Distinct types of magic, wizardry, and witchcraft will emerge naturally during world generation, influenced by the specific history and geography of the environment.
*   **Research and Discovery:** Players can conduct magical research that feels like true exploration, leading to the discovery of unique materials, enchantments, ruins, and rituals. 
*   **Environmental Interaction:** Magic will be deeply integrated into the game's physics; for example, certain spells might simultaneously damage enemies while physically shifting terrain.
*   **Systemic Depth:** Rather than a "one-size-fits-all" system, the magic is tied to the "bones" of how a particular universe functions, ensuring that magical situations are unique to each playthrough.

This update has been in development for several years and is expected to further distinguish *Dwarf Fortress* from its imitators by adding another layer of immense complexity to its already dense simulation. While the game has become more approachable since its Steam edition launch, this update promises to maintain its reputation for "horrifyingly" detailed and unpredictable gameplay.
chinese_title: 《矮人要塞》将迎来史上最重磅的魔法更新。
chinese_summary:
《矮人要塞》（Dwarf Fortress）即将推出的“神话与魔法”（Myth and Magic）更新预计于今年晚些时候发布，旨在通过深度的程序化生成彻底革新游戏中的法术系统。联合创始人 Tarn Adams 解释说，此次更新不仅限于简单的法术效果，而是将魔法融入了每个生成宇宙的“底层宇宙学构成”之中。

该更新的主要特性包括：

*   **程序化世界构建：** 不同类型的魔法、巫术和妖术将在世界生成过程中自然产生，并受到该环境特定历史和地理的影响。
*   **研究与发现：** 玩家可以进行极具探索感的魔法研究，从而发现独特的材料、附魔、遗迹和仪式。
*   **环境交互：** 魔法将深度融入游戏的物理系统；例如，某些咒语在伤害敌人的同时，可能会物理性地改变地形。
*   **系统深度：** 魔法并非“千篇一律”的系统，而是与特定宇宙运行的“骨架”紧密相连，确保每次游玩的魔法体验都是独一无二的。

该更新已开发多年，预计将通过在其已然缜密的模拟基础上增加又一层巨大的复杂性，使《矮人要塞》与其模仿者进一步区别开来。虽然自 Steam 版发布以来游戏变得更加易于上手，但此次更新承诺将维持其以“令人惊骇”的详尽细节和不可预测的游戏玩法而闻名的声誉。
